Shop.title: Shop
Shop.description: A customer-defined business profile or shop, allowing developers/merchants to run multiple isolated shops under one login.

userId.description: The unique ID of the merchant who owns this shop.

name.description: The custom name of this specific store.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: An order placed for a business product, tracking customer name, phone, size, color, quantity, price, and shipping details.

userId.description: The unique ID of the business owner who managed this order.

shopId.description: The specific shop ID isolating this order.

customerName.description: Name of the customer who ordered.

size.description: Size of the product (e.g. S, M, L, XL, etc.)

price.description: Single unit price or total order value in Currency.

status.description: Current dispatch and fulfillment state of the order.

notes.description: Additional custom delivery instructions or comments.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: A business catalog item containing naming, pricing, and variant options like sizes and colors.

userId.description: The unique ID of the business owner defining this product.

shopId.description: The specific shop ID isolating this catalog item.

name.description: The brand or descriptive name of the item.

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit unique short code/ID.

price.description: Retail price of a single unit.

sizeOptions.description: List of available sizes for this product.

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: A credit or payment due record (TaliKhata) for tracking merchant receivables/payments.

userId.description: The unique ID of the merchant who managed the ledger entry.

shopId.description: The specific shop ID isolating this ledger record.

customerName.description: Name of the customer or vendor party.

customerPhone.description: Contact phone number of the target customer/party.

reason.description: Purpose or descriptive reason for the credit/payment.

entryDate.description: The transaction date when the customer took or gave money.

/shops/{shopId}.description: Isolated business profiles managed by merchants.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Orders collection containing individual client orders managed by business owners, separated by shopId.

/products/{productId}.description: Catalog items/products collection managed by individual business owners, separated by shopId.

/ledger/{entryId}.description: Ledger entries/records for keeping track of credits and payments under specific shops.
